```{r}
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(nestedcv)
library(pROC)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)
library(patchwork)
library(broom)
library(ragg)


source(here("functions.R"))
theme_set(figTheme())
figs <- list()
```

Import
```{r}
meta <- readRDS(here("00_setup/data/metadata.samples.postQC.rds"))
analytes <- readRDS(here("00_setup/data/metadata.analytes.rds"))
model <- readRDS(here("04_prediction_model/data/nestedcv.rds"))
counts <- read_parquet(here("00_setup/data/count_tidy.postQC.parquet"))
```

# Summary
```{r}
model$summary
```

# Held-out predictions

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=4}
test_predictions_refdx <- map(1:nrow(meta), \(x) {
  model$outer_result[[x]]$preds
}) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  rownames_to_column("study_id") %>%
  left_join(meta[, c("study_id", "ref_dx")], by = "study_id") %>%
  mutate(ref_dx = fct_recode(ref_dx, "non-GCA" = "not_cGCA", "GCA" = "cGCA"))
(figs$test_predictions_refdx <- test_predictions_refdx %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = ref_dx, y = predyp)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = ref_dx), width = 0.25) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_richtext(
    data = tidy(wilcox.test(predyp ~ ref_dx, data = test_predictions_refdx)),
    aes(
      x = 1.5,
      y = Inf,
      vjust = 0.75,
      label = paste0(formatPvalLabel(p.value))
    ),
    size = 3.5,
    fill = NA,
    label.color = NA
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col.dx) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Prediction score", title = "Held-out predictions") +
  theme(legend.position = "none"))
```

Group medians
```{r}
test_predictions_refdx %>%
  summarise(median = round(median(predyp), 2), .by = ref_dx)
```


# ROC + AUC
```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=3}
auc_95ci <- ci.auc(model$roc)

(figs$test_roc <- tidyROC(model$roc) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = specificity, y = sensitivity)) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = 1,
    xend = 0,
    y = 0,
    yend = 1,
    color = "grey",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_path(linewidth = 0.5, colour = "red") +
  annotate(
    geom = "text",
    label = paste0(
      "AUC: ",
      round(auc_95ci[2], 2),
      " (",
      round(auc_95ci[1], 2),
      "-",
      round(auc_95ci[3], 2),
      ")"
    ),
    x = -Inf,
    y = -Inf,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = -1,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  labs(
    x = "Specificity",
    y = "Sensitivity",
  ))
```


# Model coefficients + importance
```{r fig.height=7, fig.width=10}
predictor_df <- var_stability(model, percent = TRUE) %>%
  rownames_to_column("apt_id") %>%
  left_join(analytes[, c("apt_id", "apt_label")], by = "apt_id") %>%
  filter(final == "yes") %>%
  mutate(direction = str_to_title(direction))

(figs$model_predictors <- ggplot(
  predictor_df,
  aes(y = frequency, x = fct_reorder(apt_label, mean))
) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = frequency)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 112)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Purples", direction = 1) +
  labs(y = "Inclusion frequency", fill = "Frequency", x = NULL) +
  figTheme("box") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 20)
  ) +
  ggplot(predictor_df, aes(y = mean, x = fct_reorder(apt_label, mean))) +
  ggstats::geom_stripped_cols() +
  geom_pointrange(aes(
    ymin = mean - sem,
    ymax = mean + sem,
    colour = direction,
    shape = direction
  )) +
  labs(
    y = "Variable importance (%)",
    x = NULL,
    shape = "Coefficient sign",
    colour = "Coefficient sign"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Positive" = "#B53737FF", "Negative" = "#00344AFF")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 45), limits = rev) +
  figTheme("box") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.justification.inside = c(1, 1),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(size = 0.5)
  ) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 2)))
```

# GCA validation
External C-GCA validation
Generalisability to remission
Generalisability to LV-GCA

```{r}
cunningham <- list()
cunningham$predictions <- readRDS(here(
  "04_prediction_model/data/cunningham.predictions.rds"
))
cunningham$meta <- readRDS(here("04_prediction_model/data/cunningham.meta.rds"))

cunningham$predictions <- cunningham$predictions %>%
  left_join(cunningham$meta, by = c("unique_id", "dx")) %>%
  mutate(study_group = str_to_title(study_group))

# set GCA classification to be Control for Controls
cunningham$predictions <- cunningham$predictions %>%
  mutate(
    gca_classification = if_else(
      study_group == "Control",
      "Control",
      gca_classification
    )
  )

# set colours for Control, Active and Inactive
colours_gca <- c(
  "Control" = "#E69F00",
  "Active" = "#0072B2",
  "Inactive" = "#56B4E9"
)
```

Collect ROC thresholds and AUCs (95% CIs)
```{r}
tmp <- map(c("Active", "Inactive"), function(x) {
  roc_obj <- roc(
    study_group ~ prediction,
    data = cunningham$predictions %>% filter(study_group %in% c(x, "Control")),
    levels = c("Control", x)
  )
  rocs <- tidyROC(roc_obj) %>% mutate(study_group = x)
  aucs <- tidyAUC(roc_obj) %>% mutate(study_group = x)
  return(list(roc = rocs, auc = aucs))
}) %>%
  set_names(c("Active", "Inactive"))

cunningham$auc <- map(names(tmp), \(x) pluck(tmp, x, "auc")) %>% list_rbind()
cunningham$roc <- map(names(tmp), \(x) pluck(tmp, x, "roc")) %>% list_rbind()
```
Model predictions
```{r fig.height=2, fig.width=3}
figs$gca$predictions <- cunningham$predictions %>%
  mutate(
    study_group = factor(
      study_group,
      levels = c("Control", "Active", "Inactive")
    ),
    study = "GCA<br>Cunningham et al., 2024"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = study_group, y = prediction)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = study_group), width = 0.25) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) +
  #stat_summary(fun = "median", width = 0.25, size = 0.25, geom = "crossbar") +
  geom_richtext(
    data = map(c("Active", "Inactive"), \(x) {
      tidy(wilcox.test(
        prediction ~ study_group,
        data = cunningham$predictions %>%
          filter(study_group %in% c("Control", x))
      )) %>%
        mutate(study_group = x)
    }) %>%
      list_rbind() %>%
      mutate(
        bonf_p = p.adjust(p.value, method = "bonferroni"),
        bonf_label = map_chr(bonf_p, formatPvalLabel)
      ),
    aes(x = study_group, y = Inf, vjust = 0.5, label = bonf_label),
    size = 3,
    fill = NA,
    label.color = NA
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Disease activity", y = "GCA prediction score") +
  facet_wrap(~study) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colours_gca) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
figs$gca$predictions
```

Group medians
```{r}
cunningham$predictions %>%
  summarise(median = round(median(prediction), 2), .by = study_group)
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=3}
        cunningham$auc %>%
          filter(study_group == "Inactive") %>%

      )
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
```

### GCA subtypes - cranial vs large-vessel

N samples in each group
```{r}
cunningham$predictions %>% count(dx)
```



Plot predictions
```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=5}
figs$gca$predictions_study_group <- cunningham$predictions %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = study_group, y = prediction)) +
  facet_grid(
    ~ factor(
      gca_classification,
      levels = c(NA, "Cranial", "LV"),
      labels = c("Cranial" = "Cranial GCA", "LV" = "Large-vessel GCA")
    ),
    scales = "free_x",
    space = "free"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = study_group), width = 0.25) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.25, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) +
  #stat_summary(fun = "median", width = 0.25, size = 0.25, geom = "crossbar") +
  geom_richtext(
    data = expand_grid(
      type = c("Cranial", "LV"),
      group = c("Active", "Inactive")
    ) %>%
      pmap(\(type, group) {
        tidy(wilcox.test(
          prediction ~ dx,
          data = cunningham$predictions %>%
            filter(
              gca_classification %in% c("Control", type),
              study_group %in% c("Control", group)
            )
        )) %>%
          mutate(
            gca_classification = type,
            study_group = group,
            bonf_label = map_chr(
              p.adjust(p.value, method = "bonferroni"),
              formatPvalLabel
            )
          )
      }) %>%
      list_rbind(),
    aes(x = study_group, y = Inf, vjust = 0.75, label = bonf_label),
    size = 3,
    fill = NA,
    label.color = NA
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.1))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "GCA prediction score", colour = "Disease activity") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colours_gca)
figs$gca$predictions_study_group
```
Calculate ROC curves and AUC
```{r}
gca_subtype_roc <- map(
  c("active_Cranial", "inactive_Cranial", "active_LV", "inactive_LV"),
  \(x) {
    roc_obj <- roc(
      dx ~ prediction,
      data = cunningham$predictions %>% filter(dx %in% c(x, "Control_NA")),
      levels = c("Control_NA", x)
    )
    rocs <- tidyROC(roc_obj) %>% mutate(dx = x)
    aucs <- tidyAUC(roc_obj) %>% mutate(dx = x)
    list(roc = rocs, auc = aucs)
  }
) %>%
  set_names(c("active_Cranial", "inactive_Cranial", "active_LV", "inactive_LV"))
```

```{r}
map(c("active_Cranial", "inactive_Cranial", "active_LV", "inactive_LV"), \(x) {
  pluck(gca_subtype_roc, x, "auc")
}) |>
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
  )) +
```

# Disease controls
```{r}
covid <- list()
covid$predictions <- readRDS(here(
  "04_prediction_model/data/gisby.predictions.rds"
)) %>%
  # recode as covid + or - %>%
  mutate(
    group = if_else(WHO_severity == "negative", "Negative", "Positive")
  ) %>%
  select(!WHO_severity) %>%
  rename(study_id = sample_id)

sle <- list()
sle$predictions <- read_parquet(here(
  "04_prediction_model/data/sle.prediction.parquet"
))

# project back onto full TABUL cohort
tabul_predictions <- data.frame(
  prediction = predict(
    model,
    newdata = counts %>%
      filter(apt_id %in% row.names(model$final_coef)) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        id_cols = study_id,
        names_from = apt_id,
        values_from = log2_RFU
      ) %>%
      column_to_rownames("study_id"),
    type = "response"
  )
) %>%
  rename(prediction = 1) %>%
  rownames_to_column("study_id") %>%
  left_join(meta[, c("study_id", "ref_dx")], by = "study_id") %>%
  rename(group = ref_dx) %>%
  mutate(study = "TABUL")
```

```{r fig.height=3,  fig.width=6}
figs$disease_controls <- bind_rows(
  sle$prediction %>%
    mutate(study = "SLE<br>Leung et al., 2026") %>%
    rename(study_id = SampleId, group = Group)
) %>%
  bind_rows(covid$prediction %>% mutate(study = "ESKD<br>Gisby et al., 2022"))

(figs$disease_controls <- figs$disease_controls %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_match(
      group,
      "Negative" ~ paste0(
        "SARS-CoV2\nNegative\n(n = ",
        nrow(filter(figs$disease_controls, group == "Negative")),
        ")"
      ),
      "Positive" ~ paste0(
        "SARS-CoV2\nPositive\n(n = ",
        nrow(filter(figs$disease_controls, group == "Positive")),
        ")"
      ),
      "Healthy" ~ paste0(
        "Control\n(n = ",
        nrow(filter(figs$disease_controls, group == "Healthy")),
        ")"
      ),
      "SLE" ~ paste0(
        "SLE\n(n = ",
        nrow(filter(figs$disease_controls, group == "SLE")),
        ")"
      ),
      .default = group
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = prediction)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.25, colour = "grey") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun = "median", width = 0.25, size = 0.25, geom = "crossbar") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  facet_grid(
    ~ factor(
      study,
      levels = c(
        "TABUL",
        "ESKD<br>Gisby et al., 2022",
        "SLE<br>Leung et al., 2026"
      )
    ),
    space = "free",
    scale = "free_x"
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "GCA prediction score"))
```
```{r}
bind_rows(
  sle$prediction %>%
    mutate(study = "SLE<br>Leung et al., 2026") %>%
    rename(study_id = SampleId, group = Group)
) %>%
  bind_rows(
    covid$prediction %>% mutate(study = "ESKD<br>Gisby et al., 2022")
```
